name: CONTROL_LOOP_ARCHITECTURE
description: Token-level control loop architecture. Initial 5-gap survey followed by deep statistical validation (5 tests), stop-vs-ending test, and extension analysis. The 'three orthogonal cycling dimensions' model was rejected; replaced by steady-state extraction pass model with two parametric axes.
prerequisite: Phase 440 PREFIX_GLOSS_VALIDATION: 12 atom glosses refined (k=heat, t=drive, e=cool, h=watch, l=collect, d=seal, s=separate, i=iterate, n=halt, a=accept, m=final, r=flow)

gap1_cycle_boundaries.title: Cycle Boundary Detection
gap1_cycle_boundaries.key_finding: FL regression, mode alternation, and channel switching are statistically independent but carry near-zero information. All three occur at ~40-46% regardless of other dimensions. Initial interpretation ('three orthogonal cycling dimensions') was REJECTED by deep analysis — independence reflects near-randomness, not meaningful cycling.
gap1_cycle_boundaries.revised_by: deep_analysis (tensor test: chi2=23.56, Cramer's V=0.12; mode entropy 97.8% of max; mutual info <1%)

gap2_iteration_atoms.title: Iteration Atom Grammar

i_count_pattern.note: ii is MORE common than i (inverted gradient per C1204). ii+n = formal bounded cycling with mandatory halt-check. i without n = open cycling without formal check.

gap2_iteration_atoms.key_finding: Iteration atoms specify loop parameters at line-initial. ii (formal bounded cycling, 92.6% n-accompanied) is the default mode; i (open cycling, 52.9% n-accompanied) is the lighter variant. The ii/i distinction is formalization of cycling, not a literal pass count — consistent with C1204 inverted gradient where the doubled form is more common. Two-track system: infrastructure prefixes (da/sa/ta/ka) + iin at line start; scaffold/energy prefixes (ok/ot/lk) + aiin at penultimate.
gap2_iteration_atoms.constraint_candidate: C1234: Iteration atoms form a two-track system — iin at line-initial (29.6%, infrastructure prefixes da/sa/ta/ka) for cycle setup, aiin at penultimate (14.1%, 1.35x enriched, scaffold/energy prefixes ok/ot/lk) for bounded loop control. ii = formal bounded cycling (92.6% n-accompanied), i = open cycling (52.9% n-accompanied).

gap3_decision_points.title: Decision Point Architecture

m_final.note: Strongest signal: m=final is 30x enriched at line-final

gap3_decision_points.key_finding: Line-final position is a ROUTING DECISION, not a processing step. Active processing atoms (k, e) are depleted 0.5-0.6x. Decision atom m (29.77x) and routing prefixes (ar 9.57x, al 6.21x, or 5.38x) dominate. IMPORTANT: 'STOP' at line-final means batch-close within the paragraph, NOT paragraph termination (see stop_vs_ending test).
gap3_decision_points.constraint_candidate: C1235: Line-final tokens constitute routing decisions, not processing steps. Active kernel atoms (k, e) are depleted 0.52-0.63x; decision atom m is enriched 29.77x; routing prefixes (ar 9.57x, al 6.21x, or 5.38x) dominate.

gap4_suffix_scope.title: Suffix Scope Markers
gap4_suffix_scope.key_finding: Terminal suffixes (-edy 3.0x, -dy 2.5x) are Mode A specification markers. Checkpoint suffixes (-aiin 1.25x) are mode-independent loop controllers. Mode A = specify batch parameters, Mode B = execute with minimal marking.
gap4_suffix_scope.constraint_candidate: C1236: Terminal suffixes (-edy, -dy, -eey) are Mode A specification markers (2.5-3.0x enriched). Checkpoint suffixes (-aiin, -ain) are mode-independent loop controllers. Mode A lines average 36.1% terminal suffixes; Mode B lines average 62.0% bare tokens.

gap5_control_traces.title: Integrated Control Loop Traces
gap5_control_traces.key_finding: Traces confirm within-line structure (setup, process, route) and across-line envelope (spec-to-exec gradient per C932). Mode A/B cycling is visible but unpredictable in sequence.

test1_decision_predictors.strongest_predictor: Mode A/B (STOP is 52.7% Mode A vs 38.7% for CONTINUE)
test1_decision_predictors.finding: Mode A is the strongest predictor of line-final STOP classification. Kernel balance, token count, and FL stage have minimal predictive power.

test2_stop_by_position.finding: STOP rate is flat across paragraph position. The paragraph is a STEADY-STATE processor, not a countdown toward termination.

test3_kernel_ordering.finding: First-occurrence ordering is e -> k -> h (cool -> process -> monitor), not e -> h -> k from C873 mean positions. Both valid — C873 measures center of mass, this measures initiation sequence. Expert confirmed no contradiction.

test4_bigram_motifs.finding: No stereotyped word sequences. Grammar composes each line fresh. Only routing-to-iteration pairs (or->aiin, ar->aiin) show elevated PMI.

test5_mode_entropy.finding: Mode transitions are near-random (97.8% of max entropy). No structured ABABAB cycling. Run lengths match random expectations. Mode A/B is a line-level property, not a cycling dimension.

stop_vs_ending.title: STOP vs Paragraph Ending Test
stop_vs_ending.finding: Line-final 'STOP' tokens (-am, -edy) are batch-close signals WITHIN the paragraph, not paragraph termination. -am at paragraph-final TOKEN is 5.19x enriched — the actual paragraph termination signal. -edy depleted 0.58x on last lines (mid-paragraph specification). Last body lines are shorter (7.3 vs 10.0), more e-heavy (cooling down), with -aiin enriched 2.22x (loop return).
stop_vs_ending.constraint_candidate: C1237: -am is the paragraph termination signal (5.19x enriched at paragraph-final token, 29.25x at line-final generally). Terminal suffixes (-edy 0.58x, -am 0.53x on last lines) are batch-close within paragraphs, not termination signals. Last body lines are shortened (7.3 vs 10.0 tokens) and cooling-enriched (e-kernel 60.8% vs 57.0%).

i_extension.finding: ii is the default form (more common than i per C1204). ii at line-initial specifies formal bounded cycling with mandatory halt-check. i = open cycling without formal check. The doubling is formalization, not a literal count — consistent with C1204 inverted gradient and distillation physics (you don't do multiple passes on a single fraction step).

e_extension.connection_to_C1226: ke/ek ratio is process-conditioned (REGIME_1: 81.4% ke; REGIME_4: 64.0% ek)
e_extension.finding: e-extension encodes the heat:cool ratio — the hysteresis window width. More e's = more cooling relative to heating. ee is Mode A enriched (1.56x) because specification lines set thermal parameters. Connects directly to C1225 (e-depth parametricity) and C1226 (ke/ek process conditioning).

synthesis.rejected_model: The initial 'three orthogonal cycling dimensions' (FL regression, mode alternation, channel switching) was REJECTED. All three signals are statistically independent because they are near-random, not because they represent meaningful cycling. Mode entropy 97.8%, mutual information <1%, STOP rate flat across position.
synthesis.accepted_model: The control loop is a STEADY-STATE EXTRACTION PASS repeated per line, with two parametric axes and one termination signal.
synthesis.within_line_architecture: Each line is one extraction pass: (1) ii-specification at line-initial declares loop parameters, (2) e->k->h kernel ordering (cool->process->monitor) fills the interior, (3) aiin at penultimate bounds the iteration, (4) line-final routing decides batch-close (-am/-dy) or continue (BARE).
synthesis.two_parametric_axes: The line has two tunable parameters: (a) ii/i at line-initial = formal vs open cycling specification; (b) ee-count in ke-family tokens = heat:cool ratio / hysteresis window width (per C1225/C1226). Both extensions are operational parameters, not grammatical categories.
synthesis.paragraph_termination: -am is the paragraph termination signal (5.19x enriched at paragraph-final). Last body lines are shortened (7.3 vs 10.0 tokens) and cooling-enriched (e 60.8% vs 57.0%). The paragraph runs at steady state until -am fires — there is no countdown.
synthesis.mode_ab_reinterpretation: Mode A/B is not a cycling dimension (entropy 97.8%). Mode A = specification lines (terminal suffixes, more ee, set parameters). Mode B = execution lines (bare tokens, continue processing). The sequence is near-random because which mode a line needs depends on process state, not on the previous line.
synthesis.cross_line_independence: Confirmed by this phase and supported by C670 (vocabulary coupling null), C673 (CC independence), C972 (independence stronger than random Markov), C966 (no cross-line memory). Each line is an independently composed instruction.

expert_validation.conflicts: ZERO conflicts with existing constraint base
expert_validation.tier_assessment: Cross-line independence: Tier 2. Kernel first-occurrence ordering: Tier 2. -am paragraph termination: Tier 2. ii formalization interpretation: Tier 3. ee as hysteresis window: Tier 3-4.

new_constraints.C1233: REVISED: Cross-line FL regression (40.7%), suffix mode alternation (45.7%), and prefix channel switching (41.7%) are statistically independent AND near-random (mode entropy 97.8%, mutual info <1%). Cross-line sequencing is unstructured; each line is an independently composed extraction pass. Supported by C670, C673, C972.
new_constraints.C1234: Iteration atoms form a two-track system: iin at line-initial (29.6%, infrastructure prefixes) for cycle setup, aiin at penultimate (1.35x enriched, scaffold/energy prefixes) for bounded loop control. ii = formal bounded cycling (92.6% n-accompanied, default form per C1204), i = open cycling (52.9% n-accompanied).
new_constraints.C1235: Line-final tokens are routing decisions: m-atom 29.77x enriched, active kernels (k/e) depleted 0.52-0.63x, routing prefixes (ar 9.57x, al 6.21x) dominate. Batch-close within paragraph, not paragraph termination.
new_constraints.C1236: Terminal suffixes (-edy, -dy) are Mode A specification markers (2.5-3.0x enriched). Checkpoint suffixes (-aiin) are mode-independent loop controllers. Mode A = specification (36.1% terminal); Mode B = execution (62.0% bare).
new_constraints.C1237: -am is the paragraph termination signal (5.19x enriched at paragraph-final token). Last body lines are shortened (7.3 vs 10.0 tokens), cooling-enriched (e-kernel 60.8% vs 57.0%), with -aiin enriched 2.22x. The paragraph runs at steady state until -am terminates.
new_constraints.C1238: First-occurrence kernel ordering within lines is e -> k -> h (cool 64.6% before heat, +14.6pp above chance; heat 71.7% before monitor). Refines C873 mean-position ordering; measures initiation sequence rather than center of mass.
